assessment_summary.project_name: Cathode Air Manifold CFD – 120 kW Fuel Cell
assessment_summary.cou_name: Preliminary manifold design selection and blower sizing with 10% margin on pressure loss and <8% outlet maldistribution at 300 SLPM

evidence_keywords: three meshes were generated from the same CAD
Coarse: 2.3 million cells
Relative changes:
remaining grid effect for pressure loss is estimated to be on the order of 1–2%
Scaled residuals were reduced below 1e-5
last 100 iterations showing less than 0.1% change
repeating the coarse run with 50% smaller relaxation factors altered the results by <0.3%
k-omega SST variant with production limiter active
Wall treatment is fully resolved to the viscous sublayer
Spalart–Allmaras and realizable k–epsilon were run
Two alternative turbulence closures provide similar outputs
mass-flow inlet set to achieve the program’s three operating points
turbulence intensity assumed 5% with a length scale equal to 7%
Each of the eight outlets was assigned a fixed static pressure
Air properties at 25 C: density 1.184 kg/m^3
room-temperature flow bench
200, 300, and 400 standard L/min
downstream adjustable orifice pack to emulate the stack resistance
CFD and bench comparisons use the same reference density
orifice pack to emulate the stack resistance
The eight outlets use identical target values
CFD (Fine) 2.01 kPa vs. bench 2.13 kPa
CFD (Fine) 3.09 kPa vs. bench 3.46 kPa
Bench maldistribution index: 6.8%
CFD (Fine) maldistribution index: 6.0%
